# convoy_project (Data Source)

Look up a Convoy project. Works with a project API key, which makes it a handy way to inspect the project the key belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The provider's default project.
data "convoy_project" "current" {}

output "project_type" {
  value = data.convoy_project.current.type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `logo_url` (String) Logo URL.
- `name` (String) Project name.
- `organisation_id` (String) Owning organisation.
- `type` (String) `outgoing` or `incoming`.
